summary: Auto-scrolling multi-line text synced to a timeline, with the current line highlighted.
overview: The look popularised by synced lyrics in music apps: the current line glides into view and lights up while the rest dim. Equally useful for a teleprompter, a subtitle track, or any multi-line text that should advance itself.
useCases: Subtitles that scroll rather than replacing a single line.

params.tuning: In ascending start-time order. Out of order, lines will be skipped rather than sorted.
Assigned, playback time comes from the audio, so the text cannot drift from the sound.
Scaling the active line re-flows the list, so large values make neighbours visibly shift.

gotchas.title: Timings are positional, so editing lines invalidates them
gotchas.body: Inserting a line shifts everything after it. Regenerate rather than patching.
